verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Team and Enterprise organization plans. Enterprise adds organization-level data-governance controls: audit logs capturing user actions and data access, and a Compliance API for usage data, chat histories and file content. These partly cover the 'data policies' side of the story. Nothing in the pack documents member management or permission and role controls. Missing for 10: documented member invite/remove and seat management, role- or permission-based access controls, admin-configurable data retention and training policies at the workspace level, admin console docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
